data.notes: February 2026 in Goa combined beachside electronic festivals, psytrance gatherings, Carnival parades, and several classical/world-music festivals around Old Goa and Panaji.

events.title: Monte Music Festival 2026
events.venueName: Courtyard of the Chapel of Our Lady of the Mount, Old Goa
events.summary: Fundação Oriente’s 24th Monte Music Festival ran 30 January to 1 February with free-entry performances including Sónia Shirsat & Friends, Ao Naga Choir, Asad Khan & Friends, Stuti Choral and String Ensemble, Raul & Mitali, and Ricardo Ribeiro.

events.title: Forestdelic Gathering 2026 in Goa
events.summary: Forestdelic Records’ two-day North Goa gathering was listed for 7–8 February with a trance-focused programme and 16-hour format.

events.title: Casa BACARDÍ Goa 2026: Tropical Edition
events.summary: Casa BACARDÍ’s first Tropical Edition was set for 7–8 February at W Goa with ARTBAT, Sistek, Kilimanjaro, Anyasa, Da Capo, Lifafa, and TechPanda x Kenzani on the lineup.

events.title: Viva Carnaval 2026 Float Parades
events.venueName: Porvorim, Panaji, Margao, Vasco, Mapusa and Morjim
events.summary: Goa Tourism’s official Carnaval schedule ran 13–17 February across multiple centres, with each float required to be accompanied by traditional instruments, recorded music, brass band, or live band.

events.title: The Mount Festival
events.summary: The Mount Festival in Palolem ran 13–15 February with a live concert, Goa Espiritu programme, ecstatic dance, sound healing, and DJ-pass ticketing.

events.title: Jungle Calling
events.summary: Believe Lab presented Jungle Calling at Orion Beach Club, Morjim from 20–22 February with Arjuna, Drip Drop, Giuseppe, Djantrix, Arjuna vs Govinda, ActOne, and more.

events.title: Arjun Vagale & Rashi Jey
events.summary: OddX brought Indian techno figure Arjun Vagale to Budxloft on 21 February, with Rashi Jey also on the lineup.

events.title: We Are Lost Festival — Goa Debut
events.summary: We Are Lost Festival’s Goa debut was listed for Friday, 27 February, led by Guy J and Guy Mantzur with melodic, progressive, and underground house/techno sounds.

events.title: Ketevan Music Festival
events.venueName: Ruins of St Augustine Church, Old Goa
events.summary: Ketevan Music Festival took place on 27–28 February at the ruins of St Augustine Church, featuring Baul music, Ensemble Sathanao, Kathak-meets-jazz, Imran Khan’s String Concerto for Peace, and Nadia Rebelo.

events.title: JUNA Sound Room: Liquid Earth + MÚDEE
events.summary: JUNA hosted Liquid Earth and MÚDEE on 27 February for a deep house and electro-focused Sound Room session in Anjuna.

events.title: 42nd Surashree Kesarbai Kerkar Sangeet Samaroha
events.summary: Kala Academy Goa’s 42nd Surashree Kesarbai Kerkar Sangeet Samaroha began on 28 February, opening with vocal concerts by Pallavi Patil and Bhagyesh Marathe before continuing on 1 March.

events.title: Scion Weekender: Sleep D, Von Riu + Residents
events.summary: Budxloft’s Scion Weekender second night on 28 February featured Melbourne/Naarm duo Sleep D, France’s Von Riu, and residents in a house-and-techno programme.
